title: Three promises for Bomet Central. Each starts from work already done.
cta: Which promise matters most to you?

one.title: Open NG-CDF
one.audience: For families, students and traders in all five wards
one.do1: Publish every NG-CDF bursary and project in Bomet Central, by ward and financial year
one.do2: Open, advertised bursary windows with clear criteria
one.do3: Quarterly report-backs in Silibwet Township, Singorwet, Chesoen, Mutarakwa and Ndaraweta
one.record: Served Bomet in the National Assembly as Woman Representative (2017–2022), and since 2022 as Vice-Chairperson of the Parliamentary Service Commission.

two.title: Schools, teachers & libraries
two.do1: Bursaries that keep children, especially girls, in secondary school
two.do2: Champion better terms for ECDE and primary teachers
two.do3: Follow the County Library Services law through to a public library for Bomet Central
two.record: Sponsored the County Library Services Bill (passed the Senate, 25 February 2026). Raised the welfare of Bomet's ECDE teachers in the Senate (22 February 2024).

three.title: A fair price for farmers
three.do1: Push for honest, enforced weights and measures at tea buying centres
three.do2: Back milk cooling and better market access for dairy farmers
three.do3: Bring smallholders' concerns directly to the floor of the National Assembly
three.record: Raised non-compliance with weights and measures in tea marketing, affecting smallholder farmers, in the Senate (25 May 2023).
